query:
SELECT DISTINCT g.group_id
               FROM groups g
               JOIN group_members m ON m.group_id = g.group_id
               JOIN contacts c ON c.user_id = m.contact_id
               WHERE g.is_direct_chat = 1
                 AND g.left_group = 0
                 AND c.blocked = 0
                 AND c.account_deleted = 0
               ORDER BY g.group_id
